title: Ramp platform bento
description: A big two-tone statement with an acid-lime and a grey button, then a bento of warm light-grey cards with 12px corners and hairlines: two wide cards over three tall ones. Each card has a two-tone title top-left, a white square arrow chip top-right, and a product frame rising from the bottom that lifts slightly on hover.
notes: five cards fill the 2 + 3 layout; any extra cards continue in rows of three
each card's media slot fills the frame under its title; empty, it shows a soft grey pane
